title: The jail keeper's gable end is boarded, not shingled
items: The keeper's house beside the log jail on the public square took its roof covering right down the end gable. The 1902 plate of the compound draws horizontal boarding carrying on around the loft light in that triangle, so the end now wears the same wall finish as the walls under it.
The roof itself is untouched: same shape, same slopes, same loft light, same openings, and the other end is unchanged.
The compound still differs from both pictures in other ways, and the comparison records say where.
